sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flights"."DestAirport" AS e, "airports"."CountryAbbrev" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "flights" JOIN "airports" ON "airports"."AirportCode" = "flights"."DestAirport"  GROUP BY "flights"."DestAirport", "airports"."CountryAbbrev") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flights"."SourceAirport" AS e, "airports"."CountryAbbrev" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "flights" JOIN "airports" ON "airports"."AirportCode" = "flights"."SourceAirport"  GROUP BY "flights"."SourceAirport", "airports"."CountryAbbrev") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flights"."DestAirport" AS e, "airports"."CountryAbbrev" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "flights" JOIN "airports" ON "airports"."AirportCode" = "flights"."DestAirport"  GROUP BY "flights"."DestAirport", "airports"."CountryAbbrev") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flights"."SourceAirport" AS e, "airports"."CountryAbbrev" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "flights" JOIN "airports" ON "airports"."AirportCode" = "flights"."SourceAirport"  GROUP BY "flights"."SourceAirport", "airports"."CountryAbbrev") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "flights"."DestAirport" AS e, "airports"."CountryAbbrev" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "flights" JOIN "airports" ON "airports"."AirportCode" = "flights"."DestAirport"  GROUP BY "flights"."DestAirport", "airports"."CountryAbbrev"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT AVG("s2"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s2"
